aboutHeading: Listening Is a State of Being
aboutBodies: Suniai translates to "listening", representing a state of deep, focused, and meditative listening to divine wisdom. It goes past ordinary hearing to imply absorbing truth with a one pointed, concentrated mind.
It is said "through Suniai, even spiritual masters, seekers, and ordinary individuals elevate their consciousness, understand the nature of the cosmos, and find the path to truth."
The facilitated experiences that I offer invite a full system slow down, allowing for the unraveling of untruths, so that you may remember the power of embodying and leading from your innate wisdom.
We tune in, and let the breath be our guide.
Gently, yet unshakably, come home to your innate wisdom and trust the whispers of your heart.
There is a calling to return to wholeness through the initiation of motherhood.
The voices of our ancestors; the voices of those to come.
Within this space, time softens. The nervous system unwinds, the mind quiets, and something deeper begins to awaken.
As old layers unravel, reclaimed soul parts are revealed and restored.
I offer my work as a prayer, in service to Love, in service to Truth.
